astra.label: Edit profile
astra.detail: Frames 01-04 place the profile selector above the numbered mapping cards; the open menu marks Default with a check.

astra.label: Outside the diagram
astra.detail: Frames 11-12 highlight marker 2 and its Back button card together. Frames 15-18 let Button 0x01FF become Spare button.

astra.label: Configure swipes
astra.detail: Frames 01-02 show Ctrl and W keycaps beside Close tab, with a labeled Edit button on every row; the compact native frames preserve this layout.

astra.label: Choose an action to assign now
astra.detail: Frames 03-06 pair a left category column with right-aligned shortcut hints. The left artwork crop labels the location Behind the thumb wheel.

astra.label: No matching actions
astra.detail: Frames 03-04 show both Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut beneath the empty search state.

astra.label: Save pointer speed action
astra.detail: Frames 03-04 show Speed 1 at 800 DPI, Speed 2 at 1600 DPI and Current: 1000 DPI beside Next press: 800 DPI.

astra.label: Keyboard shortcut
astra.detail: Frames 09-12 preserve draft M across tabs and explicitly warn that choosing an action discards it. Frames 23-24 fit Ctrl + Win + Alt + Shift + Space in the compact editor.

astra.label: Ignore accidental nudges
astra.detail: Frames 01-04 show SmartShift selected, Flick sensitivity 10 and a nudge threshold of 50% of a notch. Frames 07-08 stack wheel modes in the narrow window.

astra.label: Minimum swipe distance
astra.detail: Frames 05-06 keep saved gesture actions editable while the toggle is off and explain that they require gestures to be turned on.

astra.label: Pick a window
astra.detail: Frames 07-08 show Capturing in 6s with + 6 seconds and Cancel. Frames 15-16 wrap order controls under Photo editing and color correction without truncating its name.

astra.label: Reapply mouse settings
astra.detail: Frames 01-02 show Bluetooth, firmware MPM 12.01.B0006, battery 50% and pointer speed 1000. Disconnected frames offer Edit button mappings.

astra.label: Copy device report
astra.detail: Frames 01-04 split named feature IDs into two columns and show 18 unnamed features as monospace chips with a separate Copy unnamed IDs button.

astra.label: Settings couldn't confirm that remapping resumed
astra.detail: Frames 09-10 pair a Retry control with explicit Windows tray instructions. Frames 25-26 say Copy is still unsaved and the previous assignment is still active.

astra.label: Resume remapping
astra.detail: Frame 02 reads Resume remapping followed by Currently paused, while Start with Windows has a checkmark. Frame 01 instead offers Pause remapping and Currently on.
